title: event-items.html
content: Breaking Change To use a custom Event Item, users must create a new, unique custom picklist value in the {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Type}} field on the Event Item. A custom Event Item behaves like an Event Item with {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Type}} = "Main event ticket". This will resolve the “ticket type is not supported for registration” error. The Event Item {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Type}} = "Other" should only be used for Products. The {{variable.Object_EventItem}} s section of the Event Wizard allows users to add different types of {{variable.Object_EventItem}} s to an {{variable.Object_Event}} . There are three primary types of {{variable.Object_EventItem}} s that can be added to an {{variable.Object_Event}} : Tickets: {{variable.Picklist_ETEventItem_Mainevent}} and {{variable.Picklist_ETEventItem_Guest}} ticket Donations Products Tickets Main Event Ticket A Main event ticket is a required Event Item, meaning that every Event must offer at least one Main event ticket. This ticket type also has the following characteristics. Primary ticket type for an Event. Use it for the target audience of the Event. It can be a free or paid ticket. Guest Ticket The Guest ticket is a secondary or alternate ticket that is used when there is a difference in price compared to the Main event ticket or to differentiate attendee populations (Ex. student vs parent). This ticket type also has the following characteristics. Not required for an Event. Can be a free or paid ticket. Used to identify Attendees that belong to separate populations, opportunities, or campaigns. Main Event Tickets The Tickets page is where you can define any Tickets to be added to your {{variable.Object_Event}} . This is where an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} can choose the Ticket they want to register for. Complete the steps below to add one or more Tickets to your {{variable.Object_Event}} . Click {{variable.button_new}} next to Tickets. In the New Ticket window, add the following information. Enter a {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_PublicItemNa}} (required). Enter a {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Description}} . Is the Ticket free or paid? If the Ticket is paid, enter the amount in the {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Price}} field. If the Ticket is free, check {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Free}} . Set {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Type}} = “Main event ticket.” Select a previously created {{variable.Object_Form}} or create a new one. Click here for more information about creating {{variable.Object_Form}} s and {{variable.Object_FormElement}} s. Enter the {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_QuantityAvai}} . If the field is left blank, the {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_QuantityAvai}} will say “999,999”. To set a minimum or a maximum number of {{variable.Object_EventItem}} s allowed per order, enter the amounts in the {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_MaxQuantity}} and/or {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_MinQuantity}} fields. More information is available here . Check the {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_WaitlistEnab}} checkbox to enable waitlisting and enter an amount in the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WaitlistCapacity}} field, if using. For more information about waitlisting, click here . Add {{variable.Object_Session}} (s) to a ticket. One or more free or paid {{variable.Object_Session}} can be added to a ticket via the {{variable.Component_EventWizard}} . Select an existing {{variable.Object_Session}} to add to the ticket from the {{variable.Field_EventWizard_AddSessions}} lookup field OR click Add All Sessions to add all existing {{variable.Object_Session}} s to the ticket in bulk. Once the {{variable.Object_Session}} is related to the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} , it will be known as the {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}} . NOTE: Each {{variable.Object_Session}} can only be added to each ticket once. However, once a {{variable.Object_Session}} has been added, you can duplicate that {{variable.Object_Session}} from the “Sessions Table”. Click Save & Close . Guest Tickets Configure Guest Tickets Guest Tickets give Event Organizers flexibility in how they collect and manage guest data. There are three configuration options available: Create a Contact Record: This option allows you to create Contact records for each guest. Do Not Create a Contact Record: Select this option if you prefer not to create guest Contact records. Allow Anonymous Guest Registration: This option enables guests to register without providing their personal information. Please take a moment to review when to use each option and how it works. Create Contact Records for Guest Attendees Creating a Contact record for each guest Attendee ensures that every individual has a corresponding Contact record, even when only minimal information is provided. When to use this option: Your organization requires a Contact record for each Attendee. It is important to maintain relationship tracking between Contacts. Complete attendance records are essential for accurate reporting. You plan to collect full guest contact details at some point after the registration process. How it works: The Event Organizer checks the Event Settings {{variable.Field_EVSetting_CreContGuestTi}} checkbox. If a guest’s information is incomplete, the system will automatically: Generate the {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_LastName}} value as "[Primary Registrant's {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_LastName}} ] Guest [Number]" (e.g., "LastName Guest 1, LastName Guest 2"). Use the primary registrant's email if the guest’s email is not provided. This process prevents REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING errors while ensuring that Contact records are created. Skip Contact Creation for Guest Attendees Not creating a Contact record for guest Attendees creates an Attendee record but doesn't create the corresponding Contact record. When to use this option: You don't need relationship tracking for guest Attendees. Attendee records are sufficient for your Event reporting. You collect minimal information for guests during registration. How it works: The Event Organizer unchecks the Event Settings {{variable.Field_EVSetting_CreContGuestTi}} checkbox. The system will create Attendee records for guests. The system will NOT Create Contact records for guests. Evaluate relationship settings for guests. Allow Anonymous Guest Attendees This configuration offers the most flexibility by enabling fully anonymous guest registrations. When to use this option: You want to allow "plus one" guest registrations. You don't need to collect any information from guests. You want to avoid sending confirmation emails to guests. How it works: The Event Organizer unchecks the Event Settings {{variable.Field_EVSetting_CreContGuestTi}} checkbox. They set the Attendee Form fields for the guest Event Item to "Optional" or "Hidden." If the {{variable.Field_Attendee_Email}} field is hidden or left empty: No email will be stored on the Attendee record. A confirmation email will not be sent to the guest. If the Event Settings {{variable.Field_ETSetting_1UniqAttEmail}} field is checked, guests will be exempt from this rule, and the duplicate email error will not be triggered. Tips Data Needs: Choose a configuration that balances your need for complete Contact data with the desire to avoid creating unnecessary records. Email Communication: Note that with the first two options, if a guest's email address is the same as the primary registrant's, the confirmation emails for both the primary and guest registrants will be sent to that email address. Attendee Form Settings: Configure the checkout Attendee Form fields ( {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_FirstName}} , {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_LastName}} , {{variable.Field_Attendee_Email}} , etc.) on the Event Item based on the information you need to collect from guests. Required: The field must be filled in. Optional: The field can be left blank. Hidden: The field is hidden from the registrant. Create Guest Tickets Click {{variable.button_new}} next to Tickets. In the New Ticket window, add the following information. Enter a {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_PublicItemNa}} (required). Enter a {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Description}} . Is the Ticket free or paid? If the Ticket is paid, enter the amount in the {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Price}} field. If the Ticket is free, check {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Free}} . Set {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Type}} = “Guest.” Select a previously created {{variable.Object_Form}} or create a new one. Click here for more information about creating {{variable.Object_Form}} s and {{variable.Object_FormElement}} s. Enter the {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_QuantityAvai}} . If the field is left blank, the {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_QuantityAvai}} will say “999,999”. To set a minimum or a maximum number of {{variable.Object_EventItem}} s allowed per order, enter the amounts in the {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_MaxQuantity}} and/or {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_MinQuantity}} fields. More information is available here . Check the {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_WaitlistEnab}} checkbox to enable waitlisting and enter an amount in the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WaitlistCapacity}} field, if using. For more information about waitlisting, click here . Add {{variable.Object_Session}} (s) to a ticket. One or more free or paid {{variable.Object_Session}} can be added to a ticket via the {{variable.Component_EventWizard}} . Select an existing {{variable.Object_Session}} to add to the ticket from the {{variable.Field_EventWizard_AddSessions}} lookup field OR click Add All Sessions to add all existing {{variable.Object_Session}} s to the ticket in bulk. Once the {{variable.Object_Session}} is related to the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} , it will be known as the {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}} . NOTE: Each {{variable.Object_Session}} can only be added to each ticket once. However, once a {{variable.Object_Session}} has been added, you can duplicate that {{variable.Object_Session}} from the “Sessions Table”. Click Save & Close . Important Notes An Event Item’s {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_QuantiRemain}} will appear on the registration page only when there are 10 or fewer available. The default sort order for the added {{variable.Object_Session}} s is alphabetical. {{variable.Object_Session}} can also be sorted by {{variable.Field_Session_StartDate}} . {{variable.Object_Session}} fields can be modified in-line or on the "Sessions Table." Add or remove {{variable.Object_Session}} fields by completing the following steps. Navigate to Salesforce Setup > Object Manager. Search for and click on the {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}} object. Click "Field Sets." Click on "Blackthorn | Events Wizard Event Item Session Fields." Drag and drop fields into the list. To make a field required, hover over the field listed "In the Field Set" and click the wrench. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . {{variable.Object_Session}} s will not be displayed during registration when the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_UIExperience}} = {{variable.Picklist_Event_UIExp_FullWidth}} , and there is only one free {{variable.Object_EventItem}} with {{variable.Object_Session}} s. Add Custom Fields to the {{variable.Picklist_EventItem_Ticket}} page layout by completing the following steps: Navigate to Salesforce Setup > Object Manager. Search for and click on the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} object. Click "Field Sets." Click on "Blackthorn | Events Wizard Ticket Fields." Drag and drop a field into the list. To make the field required, hover over the field listed "In the Field Set" and click the wrench. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Add the {{variable.Field_EventItem_SortOrder}} field to the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} page layout to be able to re-organize the order of the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} s on the registration page. Then, select the order for each {{variable.Object_EventItem}} .   If you only want Attendees to see Sessions on their AttendeeLink and not on the Event registration page, complete the following steps.  Relate a Session to an Event Item, creating an Event Item Session.   Update the Event Settings tab visibility setting for {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_Sessions}} to “Post Registration.” {{snippet.DisplayDonationProductSeparate}} Donations Users can now add a Donation, a new type of {{variable.Object_EventItem}} , to an {{variable.Object_Event}} via the {{variable.Component_EventWizard}} . Prerequisite: If an Event includes a free Event Item (Ticket) and a Donation Event Item, a Payment Gateway is required to publish the Event. As with Guest tickets, a {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Type}} = {{variable.Picklist_ETEventItem_Mainevent}} must be included in the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} in order to publish an {{variable.Object_Event}} with a Donation {{variable.Object_EventItem}} . Click {{variable.button_new}} next to Donations. In the New Donation window, add the following information. {{variable.Field_ETWizard_Title}} (required) {{variable.Field_ETWizard_Description}} {{variable.Field_ETWizard_AddImage}} {{variable.Field_ETWizard_CustomQuestions}} {{variable.Field_ETWizard_SetAmounts}} (required) - Donation amounts can include two decimal points. Ex. $22.50    Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Products Users can now add Product, a new type of {{variable.Object_EventItem}} , to an {{variable.Object_Event}} via the {{variable.Component_EventWizard}} . As with Guest tickets, a {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Type}} = {{variable.Picklist_ETEventItem_Mainevent}} must be included in the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} in order to publish an {{variable.Object_Event}} with a Product {{variable.Object_EventItem}} . Click {{variable.button_new}} next to Products. In the New Product window, add the following information. {{variable.Field_ETWizard_ProductName}} (required) {{variable.Field_ETWizard_Description}} {{variable.Field_ETWizard_AddImage}} {{variable.Field_ETWizard_SetPrice}} Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . FAQ Q: How many Tickets can an Attendee purchase at one time? A: The Maximum Quantity or number of Tickets purchased at one time cannot be larger than 10. Please contact {{variable.Link_BlackthornSupport}} if you would like to increase the number to 25.
